newsletter.scheduler.missing.pgNet: The pg_net extension is missing from the database.

newsletter.unsub.body: We will not send you any more marketing messages. Mail about your account — if you have one — keeps working.
newsletter.unsub.unknown: This unsubscribe link is invalid or has expired.
newsletter.unsub.unknownBody: If you want to unsubscribe, reply to any of our messages and we will do it by hand.
newsletter.unsub.resubscribe: That was a mistake — subscribe me again
newsletter.form.consent: I want to receive the GrovBase newsletter and agree to my email address being processed for that purpose.

newsletter.err.noServerKey: The server key (GROVBASE_SERVER_KEY) is missing, so the token cannot be derived. Set it in the deployment configuration.
newsletter.err.noSiteUrl: The public address of this deployment is unknown, so there is no worker URL to store.
newsletter.err.suppressedAddress: One of these addresses is on the block list. We will not send it even a test — remove it from the test addresses.
newsletter.err.name: Enter a name.
newsletter.err.subject: The subject cannot be empty.
newsletter.err.audience: Pick at least one recipient group.
newsletter.err.noRecipients: This campaign has not a single recipient who may receive it.
newsletter.err.date: Enter a valid date and time.
newsletter.err.past: That time has already passed — pick a future one.
newsletter.err.key: A key may contain only lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
newsletter.err.aiUnavailable: The AI provider is not configured.
newsletter.err.aiFailed: The AI did not answer. Try again.
newsletter.err.sending: This campaign cannot be changed right now — it is being sent.
newsletter.err.state: This campaign has changed state since you opened this page. Refresh and try again.
newsletter.err.builtin: A built-in template cannot be deleted. Copy it and edit the copy.
newsletter.ai.campaignHint: The AI reads this campaign's copy from the database — not what you have open in the editor.
newsletter.ai.goalPlaceholder: E.g. sell the 500-credit pack to shops that tried the generator.
newsletter.ai.offerPlaceholder: What exactly are you offering? Put prices, terms and dates here — the AI will invent none of them.
newsletter.ai.bodyHint: Paste a body, or leave it empty to work on the last generated draft.
newsletter.ai.bodyPlaceholder: Paste the message you want to improve.
newsletter.ai.analyzeHint: Six questions about this particular message. No scores.
newsletter.ai.noScoreNote: There is deliberately no "87/100" here. A number like that comes out of the same guessing as the prose and is accountable to nothing — a specific finding and a specific fix can be checked.
newsletter.ai.variantsHint: Each variant tests one hypothesis. Two versions that differ in adjectives measure nothing.
newsletter.ai.sees: The AI is given only a first name, a language and a signup source. No address, no tags, no history, and no other contact.
newsletter.ai.sampleEmpty: This campaign has no contacts to show a sample from.
newsletter.ai.costUnknown: We do not know what {model} costs: nothing in the panel stores its token pricing. Enter a per-call cost for the model under AI Models and we will work it out exactly. We will not show you a made-up figure.
newsletter.ai.batchDone: Every queued message has its own subject and opener.
newsletter.ai.copyFailed: The browser refused clipboard access — select and copy by hand.
newsletter.err.aiNoQueue: This campaign has no queued messages yet. Schedule the send first, then run personalisation — writing copy after a send has started would only reach some of the recipients.
newsletter.editor.empty: This message is still empty. Add the first block.
newsletter.editor.logoNote: The GrovBase logo is inserted for you. This block only sets where it sits.
newsletter.editor.dividerNote: A hairline between sections. There is nothing to configure.
newsletter.editor.field.label: Label
newsletter.editor.urlHint: Only addresses starting with http:// or https:// make it into the message.
newsletter.editor.focusFirst: Click the field you want it inserted into first.
newsletter.preview.note: This is the message the recipient gets — minus the pixel and the rewritten links: a preview is not allowed to add itself to the campaign's numbers.
newsletter.preview.empty: Nothing to show yet. Write the message in the “Content” step.
newsletter.campaign.cancelBody: The queue stops and everything that has not gone out is cancelled. What the mail server has already accepted cannot be recalled.
newsletter.campaigns.createHint: The name is for you alone. Recipients see the subject line, not the campaign name.
newsletter.ab.needsVariant: The A/B test is on, but the first message has only one version — with no variant B the campaign goes out unsplit.
newsletter.contacts.blockBody: Nothing more will go to these addresses, and anything already queued is cancelled. The contacts, their history and their recorded consent stay untouched — you can lift a block under "Unsubscribed and blocked".
newsletter.contacts.exportTruncated: The file holds the first {n} contacts and is not the whole list. Narrow the filters and download it in parts.
newsletter.contacts.addedSuppressed: Contact added, but without consent: this address is on the block list. If that is a mistake, lift the block under "Unsubscribed and blocked".
newsletter.contact.consentGrantHint: We store the date, the source and the consent wording version — this is an operator's assertion, not an assumption. Switching it off withdraws consent from now on; an earlier date is never overwritten.
newsletter.contact.deleteBody: The contact's whole history goes with it — sends, opens, clicks — along with the record that they ever consented. If you only want to stop mailing them, block the address instead: a block can be lifted, this cannot.
newsletter.contact.blockedNotice: This address is on the block list ({reason}). No campaign will reach it, even with consent on file.
newsletter.import.title: Import contacts from CSV
newsletter.import.hint: We recognise columns for address, first name, last name, language and tags, in English and Polish. A file with no header works too, as long as the first column holds addresses.
newsletter.import.tooLarge: That file is too large — 4 MB at most.
newsletter.import.empty: This file holds no usable address at all.
newsletter.import.consent: These people agreed to the newsletter
newsletter.import.consentHint: We store this assertion as consent: today's date, the source "import" and the wording version you name. Without it the contacts land with no consent and no campaign will ever reach them — which is the right outcome for a list that was bought or collected elsewhere.
newsletter.suppressions.addHint: The address does not have to be on the contact list — you can block it before anyone adds it.
newsletter.suppressions.removeTitle: Lift the block on this address?
newsletter.suppressions.removeBody: The address comes back into the pool, but nothing reaches it on its own: without recorded marketing consent no campaign includes it. If the person unsubscribed themselves, lifting the block correctly leaves them unmailable — only they can consent again.
newsletter.groups.staticHint: A fixed list. You add and remove contacts on the Contacts screen.
newsletter.groups.deleteBody: The group and its memberships go; the contacts stay. A campaign that named this group among its recipients still opens — it simply stops counting it.
newsletter.segment.noConditions: A segment with no conditions holds nobody. Add at least one.
newsletter.segment.limit: Twelve conditions is the maximum. More than that is not a segment any more, it is a query.
newsletter.segment.noCampaigns: There is no campaign to ask about yet.
newsletter.segment.tagHint: Exactly one tag, spelled as it is stored on the contact.
newsletter.templates.used: A new campaign was created from this template.
newsletter.templates.deleteBody: Campaigns already made from it are untouched — a template is copied at the moment it is used, not linked. Only the starting point for future campaigns goes.
newsletter.templates.builtinNote: A built-in template cannot be deleted. Duplicate it and edit the copy.
newsletter.templates.noneHint: A template comes from a finished campaign: open one and choose "Save as template". Nothing is seeded here for show.
newsletter.automations.notLiveBody: The rules save correctly and will survive — what is missing is the part that listens to them. Nothing in the application reads this table yet, so no group join, no form and no signup will start a sequence, however green the switch looks. Manual sends and scheduled campaigns work normally and are not affected.
newsletter.automations.deleteBody: Only the rule goes. The campaign it started stays — a sequence usually outlives the trigger that fired it.
newsletter.automations.noCampaigns: There is no campaign for an automation to send yet. Create a sequence first and write its messages.
newsletter.automations.noSteps: This campaign has no message yet.
newsletter.form.suppressed: This address was unsubscribed from our list, so we will not put it back automatically. Use the "subscribe me again" link from the unsubscribe confirmation, or write to us.

scheduler.unknownHint: The scheduler status could not be read. Refresh the page in a moment.
scheduler.noCron: The database is missing the pg_cron extension, so the scheduler cannot run — the operator needs to fix this.
scheduler.noJob: The GrovNews job is not scheduled in the database — the operator needs to fix this.
scheduler.noTrigger: The job uses the Newsletter scheduler's trigger. Configure it once under Newsletter → Sending (on the newsletter dashboard).
scheduler.activeHint: Every hour the scheduler checks whether it is time for the cycle.
scheduler.dailyOff: The daily cycle is off — the scheduler will not start anything until you turn it on.
scheduler.noTick: The scheduler has not run yet.

ai.title: AI
ai.availableHint: Analysis and drafts use the AI providers configured in the panel.
ai.missingHint: Without an AI provider the cycle only fetches sources — it does not analyse them or write drafts. Configure a provider under AI → Providers.

key.title: Server key
key.availableHint: The job can run and store its results.
key.missingHint: Without the server key the job cannot run. It is a server environment setting — the operator has to fix it.

modeDesc.REVIEW: The cycle fetches sources, analyses them, writes post drafts and prepares an edition draft. An admin publishes and sends — nothing reaches subscribers without your decision.
modeDesc.AUTOMATIC: Sufficiently confident topics are published, the edition is built and the digest is queued automatically. Topics flagged for review are never auto-published. Law and tax only from an official source and with the switch below turned on.

automation.dailyHint: When off, nothing starts on its own — you can still run the cycle manually.
automation.thresholdsHint: Topics below the thresholds are neither selected for the edition nor auto-published.
automation.sensitive: Auto-publish law and tax from official sources
automation.sensitiveHint: Off by default. Works only in automatic mode and only for sources marked as official.
automation.sensitiveWarn: Warning: law and tax texts will reach subscribers without human review. A mistake in such a text can cost a reader money — turn it on only if you trust the sources and thresholds.
automation.errInvalid: Check the values: hour 0–23, thresholds 0–100, topics 1–10.
automation.confirmBody: In automatic mode topics above the thresholds are published and the daily mail is queued without your review. Topics flagged for review still wait for you. The change applies from the next cycle.
automation.runNowHint: The same code the scheduler runs. A large cycle is split into parts — the next run finishes the rest.

run.partial: Part of the work is done. The rest continues on the next scheduled run or the next click.
run.partialAt: Part of the work is done (stage: {stage}). The rest continues on the next scheduled run or the next click.

skipped.busy: A run is in progress — try again in a few minutes.
skipped.gave_up: Today's run stopped after repeated errors. See the recent runs table for details.
skipped.failed: Today's run stopped after repeated errors. See the recent runs table for details.

run.errNoServerKey: The server key is missing — the cycle cannot run. It is a server environment setting; report it to the operator.
run.errGeneric: The cycle stopped with an error. See the recent runs table for details.

automation.noRuns: The cycle has not run yet.
automation.subDaily: The daily GrovNews cycle: fetching sources, AI analysis, one article of the day and at most one e-mail.

modeDescDaily.REVIEW: The cycle fetches sources, analyses them and writes the article of the day as a draft. You publish and send — nothing reaches subscribers without your decision.
modeDescDaily.AUTOMATIC: The article of the day publishes itself, but only when nothing in it is flagged for review — then one e-mail is queued for subscribers who have consented. A flagged article (an uncertain topic, too few topics, failing sources) waits for you. Law and tax only from an official source and with the switch below turned on.

automation.dailyHintDaily: Each cycle writes one article of the day and at most one e-mail. When off, nothing starts on its own — you can still run the cycle manually.
automation.minTopics: Min. topics in the article of the day (1–10)
automation.maxTopicsDaily: Max. topics in the article of the day (1–10)
automation.errMinTopicsRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 10.
automation.errMinTopicsAboveMax: The minimum cannot be greater than the maximum ({max}).
automation.thresholdsHintDaily: Topics below the relevance and importance thresholds do not make it into the article of the day.
automation.topicsHint: The article of the day gathers from 1 up to the maximum number of topics — only valuable ones, never filler. With fewer topics than the minimum, the article is still written but waits for your review. Without a single valuable topic, no article is written.
automation.lookbackHint: Older news does not count as today's and is not analysed. The cycle hour and dates are in Warsaw time.
automation.emailEnabled: Send the daily e-mail (automatic mode only)
automation.emailEnabledHint: When the article of the day publishes automatically, at most one e-mail a day is queued — only for subscribers who have consented. In review mode you send it yourself from the edition screen.
automation.errInvalidDaily: Check the values: hour 0–23, thresholds 0–100, topics 1–10 (minimum not above maximum), news window 12–168 hours.
automation.confirmBody5: In automatic mode the article of the day is published without your review — but only when nothing in it is flagged for review. The cycle sends at most one e-mail a day, and only to subscribers who have consented (when e-mail sending is on). A flagged article still waits for you. The change applies from the next cycle.

lastRun.warnAi: AI was unavailable — the cycle judged, wrote and sent nothing. It will try again on the next run.

lastRun.warnSources: {failed} of {sources} sources could not be read (at least half) — the article of the day waits for review.

lastRun.emailOff: E-mail sending is turned off in the settings.

pv.notAnalyzed: This item has not been analysed yet.
pv.reviewDefault: This item needs review before publishing.
pv.duplicateOfHidden: The original is not visible in this filter — switch to “All”.
pv.duplicateNoOriginal: Marked as a duplicate without an original.

dup.title: Mark as duplicate
dup.hint: The list includes items from the current view that are not duplicates themselves.

manual.title: Add an item manually
manual.lead: Add a story you found yourself — e.g. an official announcement. Do not copy the article: save only the link and your own notes.
manual.urlHint: Enter the full address starting with https://
manual.notesHint: Write in your own words what matters. Do not paste passages from the article.

sourceTypeHint.RSS: RSS feed — the list of latest posts a site publishes.
sourceTypeHint.ATOM: Atom feed — works like RSS, in a newer format.
sourceTypeHint.PUBLIC_FEED: Public JSON, RSS or Atom feed — the format is detected automatically.
sourceTypeHint.API: Needs a provider adapter that is not configured yet — the source stays unavailable and is not fetched.
sourceTypeHint.MANUAL: Never fetched — you add its items by hand in Research.
sourceTypeHint.WEB_PAGE: One public listing page; links are read with respect for robots.txt.

sources.guidance: Prefer official sources: APIs, RSS/Atom feeds, official announcements and changelogs. GrovNews never logs in and never bypasses paywalls, CAPTCHAs or robots.txt.
sources.emptyBody: Add the first source — GrovNews will fetch news from it into Research every day.
sources.ingested: Sources read: {sources} · failed: {failed} · new items: {inserted} · duplicates: {duplicates}
sources.fOfficialHint: An announcement by the platform, authority or provider itself — not a reprint.
sources.fEnabledHint: A disabled source is not fetched by the daily research.
sources.testNone: The source responded but contains no entries.

err.name: Enter a name (up to 120 characters).
err.url: Enter the full https address of a public page (no login, no IP address).
err.category: The selected category does not exist.
err.priority: Priority: a whole number from 0 to 100.
err.language: Choose a language: PL, EN or DE.
err.urlTaken: A source with this address already exists.
err.noServerKey: Fetching needs a server key that is not configured in this environment.
err.invalid: Invalid data — refresh the page and try again.

errors.requires_access: Requires a login or paid access

filters.emptyBody: Change or clear the filters to see the other sources.

check.starting: Checking the first batch of sources — this can take a few minutes.
check.note: Checking only records each source's health — it does not fetch news into Research. Enabled sources with a URL are checked.
check.stalled: Check interrupted — the last batch checked no source (checked: {checked}). Try again shortly.

sources.testNoteHealth: The test only records the source's health — it does not fetch news into Research.
sources.unsupportedNote: GrovNews never bypasses logins, paywalls, CAPTCHAs, anti-bot protection or robots.txt. Such a source stays unsupported until it offers a public channel (RSS, Atom or an open page).

recommend.title: {type} detected — recommended
recommend.body: The test found a better way to read this source. Open the form, review the details and save — nothing changes automatically.
recommend.apply: Open the form with the recommendation
recommend.formNote: Type and address were prefilled from the test's recommendation. Review them and click “Save”.

mon.title: Monetisation
mon.sub: GrovNews Premium — a monthly subscription in PLN.
mon.priceNote: A price change creates a new Stripe price for new purchases. Existing subscribers keep their price. Disabling sales only blocks new purchases — it cancels no subscription.
mon.launchSub: Free GrovNews access and a personal discount code for people who registered inside the campaign window and completed the survey.
mon.launchNote: A campaign can only be edited as a draft. After it ends new people get nothing, and granted access and codes stay. Disabling also stops unused codes. Dates in Warsaw time.
mon.priceModalNote: From 2 zł. The new price applies to new purchases; existing subscribers are not moved.
mon.salesOnBody: Customers without access will see the price and the “Activate GrovNews” button.
mon.salesOffBody: New purchases will be blocked. Existing subscriptions continue.
mon.activateBody: The campaign will start granting the bonus to eligible people. Once active it cannot be edited.
mon.endBody: New people will not get the bonus. Granted access and codes stay.
mon.disableBody: New people will not get the bonus and unused codes will stop working. Granted access stays.
mon.priceSaved: The new price is active for new purchases.
mon.priceUnchanged: Price unchanged — Stripe already has this amount.

err.no_server_key: No server key — payment changes cannot be saved.
err.stripe_error: Stripe refused the operation. The previous state is kept.
err.conflict: Someone else just changed the price. Refresh and try again.
err.reconcile_required: Stripe created the price but it could not be saved. Try again.
err.no_price: Set a price synced with Stripe first.
err.not_draft: Only a draft campaign can be edited.
err.invalid_plan: The selected plan cannot be discounted.
err.invalid_transition: This status change is not possible.
err.no_coupon: The discount could not be prepared in Stripe.
err.plan_ineligible: A plan must be paid, monthly, synced with Stripe and cost at least 2 zł after the discount.
err.window_over: The registration window has already passed.
err.access_over: The access end date has already passed.
err.form: Check the form: name, window (end after start), access and discount.
err.changed: The draft changed during activation. Refresh and activate again.

mon.fWindowHint: What counts is when the account was created. Warsaw time.
mon.fDiscount: Personal discount code for a monthly plan
mon.plansNote: Paid monthly plans synced with Stripe only. The code does not work on Free, credit packs or GrovNews. Codes do not stack.
mon.statPaidHint: cancelling at period end: {cancelling} · past due: {pastDue}
mon.statCodesHint: A code counts as used after a paid payment
mon.noClaims: Nobody has received the launch bonus yet.

blog.intro: Public SEO articles at /blog. These are separate documents — a premium post never lands here automatically. A public version of a GrovNews post starts as a draft and needs a new write-up and an admin's publish.
blog.fromPostTitle: Public version of a GrovNews post
blog.fromPostHint: Creates a DRAFT with the post's topic, category, tags and sources — not its text. The public text is a new write-up: write it yourself or generate an AI draft and check it before publishing.
blog.existed: A public version already exists — opening it.
blog.slugRedirectHint: This article has been published: after an address change the old link redirects to the new one (301).
blog.publishHint: Publishing needs a lead and a body. A text too close to the premium post will not be published.
blog.aiHint: The AI writes a NEW text based only on the published post, its sources and the research facts. It saves and publishes nothing — review and save it yourself.
blog.aiApplied: AI draft placed in the form — review and save.

warn.clickbait: The headline reads as clickbait (SHOCK, “the end of…”, “everyone…”) — use it only if the sources support it.
warn.caps: The headline has words in capitals.
warn.exclaim: The headline has an exclamation mark.
warn.long: The headline is longer than 100 characters.
warn.sameTitle: The title is the same as the premium post's — rewrite it.
warn.numbers: Numbers in the AI draft that the material does not contain: {list} — check them before saving.

blog.fNoindex: Do not index in search engines (noindex)
blog.faqHint: Questions and answers appear below the article; only then does the page carry FAQ structured data.
blog.previewNote: Admin preview — this is how the article looks on /blog. A draft is not public.
blog.errTooClose: The text is too close to the premium post. The public version must be a new write-up.
blog.errIncomplete: Publishing needs a lead and an article body.
blog.errNotPublished: A public version can only be made from a published GrovNews post.
blog.errNoSource: An AI draft needs a GrovNews source post.
blog.errAiFailed: The AI did not produce a draft. Try again shortly or write the text by hand.
blog.errCanonical: The canonical URL must start with https://
blog.errFaq: Every FAQ question needs an answer (up to 10 questions).
blog.errStale: The article changed in the meantime (in another tab, say). Reload the page and try again.

sourceImport.title: Import sources from a file
sourceImport.sub: CSV or XLSX. The file is only a proposal: every row is validated and tested, and nothing is saved until you confirm.
sourceImport.nothingSaved: Choosing a file saves nothing. Sources are added only after you click “Import selected” and confirm.

help.title: File format
help.header: The first row holds the column headers; other columns are ignored.
help.limits: Limit: {mb} MB and {rows} rows. Source types: {types}.
help.values: priority: 0–100 (default 50) · language: pl, en or de · official_source and enabled: yes/no (true/false). The category must already exist — the import never creates one.

fileErr.invalid: Invalid request — refresh the page and try again.
fileErr.generic: The file could not be read. Try again.
fileErr.file: Choose a CSV or XLSX file.
fileErr.tooLarge: The file is too large — the limit is {mb} MB.
fileErr.empty: The file contains no data rows.
fileErr.unsupported: Unsupported or damaged file — use CSV or XLSX.
fileErr.tooManyRows: The file has too many rows — the limit is {rows}.
fileErr.columns: The file is missing required columns: {columns}.

sourceImport.testingNote: The test only reads the addresses (respecting robots.txt) — it saves nothing.
sourceImport.testStalled: Test interrupted — the server read no address. Use “Test again”.

probeErr.invalid: Invalid test data — refresh the page and try again.

update.label: Update existing sources (UPDATE)
update.hint: By default, sources that already exist are skipped. When ticked, you can select them in the table: only the name, category, priority and official flag (shown in the table) are taken from the file. The address, type, language and on/off state stay unchanged.

confirm.title: Import the sources?
confirm.bodySkip: Sources to import: {count}. Sources that already exist will be skipped.
confirm.bodyUpdate: Sources to import: {count}. Sources that already exist will be updated with the file's data.

importErr.noServerKey: Importing requires a server key that is not configured in this environment.
importErr.tooMany: Too many rows at once — the limit is {rows}.
importErr.invalid: Invalid data — refresh the page and try again.

reason.untested: No valid test (it expired or was not confirmed by the server) — test again.
reason.name: Invalid name.
reason.category: The chosen category does not exist.
reason.priority: Priority must be a number from 0 to 100.
reason.not_healthy: The source did not pass the test.

problem.name: The name is empty or longer than 120 characters.
problem.formula: A cell looks like a spreadsheet formula (=, +, -, @) — it will not be imported.
problem.url_scheme: The address must start with https://.
problem.url_host: Disallowed host (a private address, an IP address or a GrovBase service).
problem.type: Unknown source type — use RSS, ATOM, PUBLIC_FEED or WEB_PAGE.
problem.type_unsupported: This type cannot be imported — add API and manual sources with the form.
problem.priority: Priority must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
problem.language: The language must be pl, en or de.
problem.duplicate_in_file: The same address is already in row {line}.
problem.retry: The source's server did not answer for now — test again.
problem.empty: The address works but lists no entries.
problem.unsupported: Unsupported — the source requires a login, blocks robots or refuses access.
problem.failed: The address could not be read.
problem.category_not_found: The category “{label}” does not exist — choose an existing one or “No category”.
problem.type_mismatch: The chosen type and address were not verified — pick a read method from the test or apply the recommendation.

sourceImport.willUpdate: Importing will update the name, category, priority and official flag.
sourceImport.officialHint: An official source is enough for a topic to publish automatically without a second source. Tick it only for the institution's or platform's own announcements.

daily.title: Article of the day — review
daily.intro: One article made from today's topics and one short e-mail that leads to it. Check both before anything reaches subscribers.
daily.approveHint: Publishes the article and the edition. Sends no e-mail.
daily.approveEditionNote: While the article is a draft, the edition cannot be marked ready or published on its own — the “Approve and publish article” button does that.
daily.approveTitle: Publish the article of the day?
daily.approveBody: The article and the edition will be published — subscribers will see them in the app. This does NOT send an e-mail: you prepare and send the e-mail after publication in the “E-mail to subscribers” section further down this page.
daily.approveBodyWarn: The article has review warnings — make sure you have checked them.
daily.approved: Article and edition published. Prepare the e-mail in the section below.
daily.publishedNote: The article is published. Prepare and send the e-mail in the “E-mail to subscribers” section further down this page.

reason.topic_review: At least one topic is flagged for checking — see the details next to the topics below.
reason.few_topics: There are fewer topics than the configured minimum.
reason.sources_failed: Some sources could not be fetched today — the article may be missing something.
reason.topic_dropped: The model left out one of the offered topics — its material was in the prompt, so the article waits for review.
reason.lead_unsupported: The headline, opening, mail intro or "What to watch next" contains a number or quote not found in the sources.

daily.automaticNote: In automatic mode, an article with any of these warnings would be neither published nor sent — it waits for your decision.
daily.noWarnings: No warnings — no topic is waiting to be checked.
daily.headline: Headline of the day
daily.emptyContent: The article has no content yet.
daily.structureNote: If you change the section layout (topic headings) in the post editor, topic editing here will be blocked.
daily.mailPreviewSaved: The preview shows the saved version — save your changes to refresh it.
daily.mailTarget: The e-mail is a short summary of the day with one link — the article provides the full 3–5 minute read.
daily.mailCopyHint: An intro and 2–3 sentences per topic. The subject and preview line come from the date and the headline of the day.
daily.mailBlank: The intro and every summary must have content.
daily.mailLocked: The e-mail copy can no longer be changed — the e-mail is queued or sent, or the edition is closed.
daily.mailCampaignLocked: The campaign is no longer a draft — the e-mail copy cannot be changed.
daily.mailCampaignNote: The e-mail is already prepared — saving also updates the campaign draft in the Newsletter.
daily.mailInReview: This e-mail's intro and topic summaries are edited in the “E-mail” panel of the article of the day further up this page.
daily.topicsLocked: Topics can only be changed while both the article and the edition are drafts.
daily.lastTopicHint: The last topic cannot be removed — if the day has no valuable topics, archive the edition.

topicReview.flagged: The AI analysis flagged this story for checking.
topicReview.sensitive_unofficial: Sensitive topic (law, tax, customs) without an official source.
topicReview.related_flagged: Another report of this story is flagged for review, or covers law or tax without an official source.
topicReview.model: The AI was not sure about the facts in this section.
topicReview.unsupported_numbers: The text contains numbers that do not appear in the sources.
topicReview.verbatim: Part of the text is too close to the source.

daily.noSources: No sources with a secure (https) address.
daily.removeTitle: Remove the topic from the article?
daily.removeBody: The section “{title}” will disappear from the article and the e-mail, and the story will return to the inbox as rejected.
daily.addFull: The article already has the maximum number of topics ({max}). Remove a topic or change the limit in Automation.
daily.noCandidates: No stories to add — nothing analysed and unused from the last hours.
daily.aiNote: Regenerating or adding a topic is one AI call — the new text is written only from the source material.

err.invalid: Invalid data — refresh the page and try again.
err.notArticle: This edition has no article of the day — refresh the page.
err.locked: This change is no longer possible in the current state of the article or edition — refresh the page.
err.lastTopic: The last topic cannot be removed — archive the edition instead.
err.structure: The article's sections no longer match the topic list (the text was changed by hand). Fix it in the post editor.
err.full: The article already has the maximum number of topics.
err.used: This story is already used — choose another one.
err.noServerKey: This environment has no server key — this cannot be done right now.
err.aiUnavailable: AI is unavailable — configure a provider in AI → Providers.
err.aiFailed: The AI did not return a valid section — please try again shortly.
err.campaignLocked: The campaign is no longer a draft — the e-mail copy cannot be changed.
err.newsletter: The Newsletter did not accept the updated campaign content — please try again.
